verdict.rationale: The source is publicly readable in the official GitHub repo (open-webui/open-webui), which documents installation from source via pip/uv/Docker/Kubernetes. However, community reporting says the project moved from BSD-3 to a custom license that requires branding retention and a CLA, which makes it a source-available-with-restrictions license rather than a standard open license. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the current license terms, confirmation that the license is OSI-approved or unrestricted, independent verification of what the license permits.
